note: How a passed Tok society scenario changes the decision engine's inputs. Trigger groups and signs follow the pre-registered expected directions in swarm/score.py (branch ahmed/gold-society-plan). Every magnitude is a labelled ASSUMPTION chosen by the algorithm owner, not a swarm output; the engine reports decisions with and without each scenario. A scenario's effect lasts for the whole contract unless stated otherwise, which is itself an assumption.

mine_approved.mirror_check: funds move opposite ways after mine approved and court blocks, both beyond the band
mine_approved.assumption: A new approved mine nearby brings buyers: 25% more staking events turn into offers.

court_blocks_mine.mirror_check: funds move opposite ways after mine approved and court blocks, both beyond the band
court_blocks_mine.assumption: A court block deters buyers: 25% fewer staking events turn into offers.

tax_rise.assumption: A proposed state mining tax rise lowers what buyers pay for the block by 15%.

protest.assumption: Local opposition makes buyers 15% less likely to follow staking with an offer.

gold_back_to_4000.mirror_check: funds and retail fall beyond their bands when gold drops back
gold_back_to_4000.assumption: Gold falling back about 11% lowers offers by 10% (a land-to-gold sensitivity of roughly 1, assumed).
